components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-context { font: 14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #f2f5f8); color-scheme: dark; } .ds-button { font: 14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 7px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--accent, #f5c542); color: #1b1405; font-weight: 600; } .ds-button-secondary { background: transparent; border-color: #3a4a5c; color: var(--text, #f2f5f8); font-weight: 400; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity: 0.45; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #f5c542); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button:not(:disabled):hover { filter: brightness(1.1); }

components.name: Mob Table

components.css: .ds-table { border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table { width: 100%; font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #f2f5f8; } .ds-table th { font-weight: 400; color: #9fb6cc; text-align: right; } .ds-table td { text-align: right; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 1px 0 1px 6px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table th:first-child, .ds-table td:first-child { padding-left: 0; text-align: left; } .ds-table td:first-child { max-width: 140px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-table { table-layout: fixed; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-table th:nth-child(1) { width: 32%; } .ds-table th:nth-child(2) { width: 8%; } .ds-table th:nth-child(3), .ds-table th:nth-child(4) { width: 17%; } .ds-table th:nth-child(5) { width: 11%; } .ds-table th:nth-child(6) { width: 15%; } .ds-table td:not(:first-child) { white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

narrative.overview:
MapleCompass is quiet, practical, and compact. Its interface reads like a small set of useful notes beside the game: a clear Map Name, tightly grouped facts, and brief signals when something needs attention. The game keeps the player's attention; the companion stays easy to consult.

Familiar, straightforward controls sit on Midnight Slate surfaces. Compass Gold identifies setup actions and marking feedback, while cool supporting text gives the Map Name and selected information room to lead. Rounded containers and translucent fills keep the system approachable without introducing ornamental depth.
keyCharacteristics: Compact facts with a clear Map Name and aligned numeric columns.
Midnight Slate surfaces, cool supporting text, and purposeful Compass Gold.
Familiar, straightforward buttons, containers, and small descriptive tags.
Flat tonal layers, subtle borders, and immediate state changes.

rules.name: The Accent Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Use Compass Gold for the existing action and marking roles. Keep recognition, uncertainty, and Quest signals in their own established status tones.

rules.name: The Facts Stay Aligned Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals in the tables, right-align numeric columns, and left-align the first descriptive column. Table headers remain regular; summary values are semibold.

rules.name: The Flat Layers Rule
rules.body: Preserve the current hierarchy with fill opacity, text emphasis, and restrained borders. Window stacking is a platform behavior, not a decorative elevation token.

dos: Do keep the Map Name prominent and supporting facts compact.
Do preserve the distinct opaque setup, translucent panel, and inset surface roles.
Do use the established status tones together with explanatory text, the uncertainty mark, or the recognised-result check mark.
Do keep numeric columns aligned and status explanations able to wrap.
Do retain familiar button variants, visible keyboard focus, and the visible disabled state.
Do keep attribution and source-page hints legible within the low-emphasis footer.
donts: Don't substitute the icon's turquoise for the Compass Gold action accent.
Don't turn descriptive portal tags or Candidate rows into controls without an explicit interaction change.
Don't ellipsize status explanations using the name-row clipping treatment.
Don't describe shadows, blur, hover animation, mobile breakpoints as established parts of this system.
Don't treat the overlay's starting height as a fixed content height.
Don't turn preview-only tonal ramps or specimen data into product colors or factual map data.
